scope: read-only inspection; no credential verification, preparation or erasure
hash: SHA-256 over all 8192 bytes in address order
binding: Owner runner verifies fresh signed identity proof, hardware, boot, role and full source; request queues a serialized worker; status is bound to current boot and accepted request ID.
results: Queued, failed, timed-out and completed states remain distinct. A successful scan emits only classification and SHA-256; no credential, raw region bytes or private key is returned. A recognizable marker is not a verified credential.
preservation: Inspection never writes or erases. Recognizable and potentially interrupted records remain protected. Unknown bytes require a separate reviewed preparation procedure and explicit content-bound confirmation.
authentication: SHA-256 is a content change detector, not authentication of an operator, device or credential.
